scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Hm...?
Can I help you?

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I'm sorry I made you wait,
but I had some research to finish and it took longer than I expected. Now, before I tell you more about the job, I want to test your competency.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I don't know if you realize
it, but I'm offering a golden
opportunity for the adventurer
who works for me. So don't
hesitate to see Arian.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Dearles...?
Ah yes, he's one
of my shadier friends.
He's difficult to find
and he's only truly kind
to a select few, so...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Congratulations~
You managed to pass
all of the tests! You seem
to be the perfect person
to carry out this special
assignment!

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Ah, you've come
just in the nick of time!
I just found someone who
may be capable of restoring
the Sobbing Starlight.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Keep up the good work.
I'm sorry that I don't have
have much information for
you to follow, but someone
with your abilities should
be able to find a way.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Amazing...! You've
managed to restore
the Sobbing Starlight!
Now, I recently learned that
this stone can lead you to
an ancient place...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Now that the
Sobbing Starlight
is restored, we need
to find someone who can
break the seal on the
gem's message...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Great...!
You were able to get the
text in the gem printed on a
Record of Ancient Language?

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Frank Franklin has lived
in seclusion and only a few
people are aware of his skill.
But I can assure you that his
knowledge of ancient languages
is unrivaled by any mortal.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
So far, I've learned
from my research that
the gem's message has
details about a certain
location and an item that
serves as some kind of key...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I get it now!
The 'skyscraper'
in this text refers to
the Geffen Tower!
Alright, let's see...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Angrboda...?!
According to legend,
her soul was split into
pieces and placed behind
seals created by the gods!

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Fascinating...
This was made with
a material outside of
Midgard! See this
blue lens? That must be
its incredible power source!

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Ah, you're finally
here. I've been waiting
to speak with you. First,
let me thank you again
for all of your help.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
You failed?
It's disappointing,
but I know that you
did your best. Let
me thank you for
all your work.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I'm sorry...
But I'm taking
back the Sobbing
Starlight from you.
Apparently, you weren't
worthy of the task...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Thank you so much
for helping me make
my dream come true.
can work on another
project together.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Although you need everlasting patience in an archaeological excavation, the feeling you get when you find something makes
all those long hours of study and research worth it.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Hm...?
Shouldn't you leave
for Morocc to see Arian?
You better hurry in case
somebody else applies
for this little job.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I'm impressed that
you managed to get
Arian's approval! Oh,
and how's Daewoon?
He's a character, isn't he?

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I'm not surprised
that Daewoon likes
you. Ah, but Jore is
always busy. Still, if you
know his schedule, you
should be alright.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Jesqurienne is
a brilliant woman.
Although I worry a
little bit about her
overconfidence, she's
a good friend of mine.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Ah, Bakerlan~
I've heard that he's
been quite busy lately.
But that's how all big
businessmen are, I suppose.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Although I've made
some progress, I still
haven't found an artisan
capable of restoring the
Sobbing Starlight. Please
give me a little more time.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
The Wizard we're looking
for isn't in Geffen? Hm, at least we know he's near Comodo. Now,
while you investigate that lead, I'll continue to gather more
information on this gem...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I'm sure the town
where the rejected
live means something,
but I'm unable to figure
out the answer to this
little riddle...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I think you're
almost there. All
of our efforts will
soon come to fruition!

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
This is it...!
You've brought me,
'The Sign!' I've finally
proven its existence!
Please let me handle
this and come back later~

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I'm sorry, but I'm
still examining the
artifact you've lent to
me. Would you please
give me some more time?

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Have you visited
Engel Howard yet?
He's the only one
who can unlock the
Sign's power for you...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Have you visited
Engel Howard yet?
He's the only one
who can unlock the
the Sign's power for you...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I guess I can't
really blame you
since I didn't provide
you with that much help...
I've been following these signs and...
I was just passing by...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Great...!
Welcome to my
humble lodgings.
Hmm, let me see...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text: Uh, it pains me to say this, but I don't think you qualified to help me out. Once you gain enough experience though, I'll be happy to have you on board~

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Hey, I think you might
be well suited for the job!
But do you think you could come back later? I've got my hands full with some other business.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Oh right, would you tell
me your name? {0}?
Okay then, I'll remember that.
Talk to you later, alright?

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Oh really?
I see, I thought you
were an applicant for
the position I'm offering
to brave adventurers.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
The job I'm offering is
pretty risky and not just
anybody can handle it.
You'll actually go through
a series of tests conducted
by my trusted friends.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Now, the first person
you must visit is ^FF0000Arian^000000
in Morocc. Please speak
to him and he'll give you
all the details about his
examination... I hope.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Once you're finished with
the test, Arian will tell you
what to do next. Afterwards,
come back to me so that we
can finally talk business.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Ah, almost forgot.
Arian won't talk to anybody
unless he knows them or
receives a message from me.
So if he's snubbed you in the past, just understand that's his way.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
And just so you know,
it's not a good idea to
judge Arian by his looks.
He's more than meets
the eye, you know.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
It certainly doesn't
help that he's hopelessly
addicted to gambling...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
By now, you must have
six Sobbing Starlight pieces.
I'm sure that you want to know
more about these fragments.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I remember last summer,
I found the wholly formed
Sobbing Starlight north
of Mount Mjolnir during
one of my expeditions...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Although it was in perfect
shape, once it was exposed
to the air, it began to crack
and shattered into the pieces
you now hold in your hand.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Now, an ordinary artisan
can't put the Sobbing Starlight
back together. This mysterious stone has some strange properties. But it's imperative for me to get this stone reassembled.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Once restored, a strange
pattern can be seen within
the Sobbing Starlight. I guess
that the pattern is a message
written in an ancient language.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Would you let me borrow
the pieces for a second?
I'll show you something
quite interesting...

^3355FFOnce you hand the pieces
of the Sobbing Starlight to
Metz, he pulls out a seventh
piece. Once gathered, they
begin to emit a strange light.^000000

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Since the pieces still
respond to each other,
I believe that it's possible
for the Sobbing Starlight
to be restored to its
original form.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
We're still seeking
an artisan of great
skill for this task. Once
know right away. For now,
please hold on to these pieces.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
His name is
^FF0000Engel Howard^000000,
a legendary Blacksmith
in Midgard. I don't
know where he is, but maybe
his family in Geffen may know.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Unfortunately, that's all
the information that I have
to give you for now. You'll
have to investigate this lead
on your own, {0}.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
While you work things
out with Engel Howard
and his family in Geffen,
I'll continue my research
on the Sobbing Starlight.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
That's why we need to
know what the message in
the Sobbing Starlight means.
First, we need a Wizard that
is skilled in unlocking the
messages stored in gems...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Hmm. It would probably
be best to visit the Wizards
on the top floor of the Geffen
Tower. There's someone I know
there who might just be up for
this task...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
For now, please visit
the Wizards at the top
floor of the Geffen Tower.
I know that one of them is
capable of getting the gem's
text on to paper...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Just as I thought.
This language isn't
one I recognize. It's
probably ^333333too^000000 ancient.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Fortunately, I know
one person who may
be able to translate this.
If he's not able to do it...
We'll have to give up.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Bring this Record
of Ancient Language
to a man named Frank.
I hope he'll be able to
understand what it says...
Who is Frank?
Where is he?
I see.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Frank Franklin has lived
in seclusion and only a few
people are aware of his skill.
But I can assure you that his
knowledge of ancient languages
is unrivaled by any mortal.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I suppose his interest
in history is what drives
him in work. Still, I've
heard that he doesn't like
meeting people. I hope you
can convince him to help us...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
It's said that
Frank Franklin lives
on the Alberta Sunken Ship
where he devotes his time
to his research. He may not
always be home though...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Good luck, then.
I hope that you can
find a way to get Frank
Franklin to help us...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I suppose his interest
in history is what drives
him in work. Still, I've
heard that he doesn't like
meeting people. I hope you
can convince him to help us...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
While I investigate,
please try to have Frank
Franklin translate the
message in the Record of
Ancient Language. Keep up
the good work, {0}.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Hmm...
''The town where the
rejected are left behind.''
What does that mean
and where could it be...?

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
You'll need a stout,
heavy or really sharp
weapon. Of course, I'm
told that such weapons
are truly rare...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Supposedly, normal
Blacksmiths can't even
forge those kinds of rare
weapons. But if you manage
to get one, you might have a
chance of breaking the seals.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Of course, I'm worried
that may be violating the
will of the gods by releasing
Angrboda, but we've already
gone this far...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I've found that the runes
around the lens control some
kind of seals placed at the Geffen Tower and Geffen Fountain. But with this in your hands, the seals should be broken...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I... I think
you can even use this
to enter Valhalla. There
may be even other applications
using the power of this item...

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
I can only think of
one person who can
handle working with
this: Engel Howard,
Midgard's best
Blacksmith.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Thanks to you, my wish
of proving the existence
of the Sign has finally been
fulfilled. Its power is now
yours to do as you wish.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
You may have had your doubts,
but I'm happy enough to confirm that the Sign really exists. Thanks again, and I hope you stop by and chat from time to time.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Although I need to
take back the Sobbing
Starlight, I hope you
accept this as a token
of my gratitude. Good luck
on your travels, adventurer.

^3355FFWait a second! Right now,
you have too many items in your inventory. Please come back after you've freed up more inventory space.^000000

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
......
Farewell.

scripts.speaker: Metz
scripts.text:
Well then...
Good luck on
your journeys,
brave {0}.

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Welcome to the
Brayde Estate. How
may I be of service?

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Ah, Master {0}.
Welcome. How may I be
of service today?

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
I recall that
Master Arian visited
the master a while ago.
They spent all night
discussing something
related to the master's work.

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Sometimes I worry
about Mistress Elle.
She's one of the most
beautiful girls in Prontera,
but does not have a boyfriend.

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Many travellers have
begun to visit the master
lastly. Apparently, they've
been led here by the sign
boards we've posted.

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
It's most curious,
but Elle seems to
consider that unrefined
Jesqurienne as her rival.
Women are truly difficult
for me to understand...

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Avarice knows no bounds.
The pastime of gambling
seems to best represent
mankind's greed.

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Bakerlan is a young,
brilliant man. Although
he inherited his company,
it takes talent to continue
his father's successes.

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Oh, congratulations~
You finally passed all
of the tests. I know they
must have been incredibly
taxing and challenging.

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Although humans make
mistakes, there are those
times when failing cannot
be an option.

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
There will always
be situations where
you won't be getting
any second chances.
Anyways remember that.
Nothing.
I'm here to see Metz.
Gimmie your cash!

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
If you do not have
any business to conduct
with Master Metz, please
leave immediately.

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Very good, {0}
Please wait a moment
while I consult with
the master in his study.

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
My apologies,
but I insist that
you leave the premises
^FF0000immediately^000000.
Who is Arian?
What is Metz doing?
How is Elle?

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Ah yes, Arian.
I consider him to be
a man of few words. The
words he does choose to
use are rather harsh and
brutish, you might say.

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Although I've served
the Brayde family for years,
I'm unfamiliar with Master
Metz's work. My apologies, but
I simply cannot even begin to fathom his research...

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Ah, Mistress Elle
has been working here
since she was a very young
girl. She is almost like
a granddaughter to me.
Ha ha-^333333*Ahem*^000000

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Goodness, it sounded
dreadfully serious. The
term, 'ancient power' is
usually not mentioned
quite often in conversation.

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Many men have given her
a great deal of attention, but
she always manages to reject
every single suitor...

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Take heed and
do not let anyone
else take the opportunity
the master has presented
away from you.

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Winning or losing, some
gamblers always seem to find
some reason to continue when
it's smarter to stop. Then again, the mind usually doesn't take precedence over the heart...

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
It's amazing that Bakerlan
is also managing to expand
his business even further.
Of course, Master Metz has
had a role in Bakerlan's
success...

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
Master Metz has informed
me that he wishes for you
to restore find someone
to restore the Sobbing
Starlight. I wish you luck
in that endeavor.

scripts.speaker: Vandez
scripts.text:
There will always
be situations where
you won't be getting
any second chances.
Anyways remember that.

scripts.speaker: Elle
scripts.text:
Wh-what are you
doing in Master Metz's
room? Please leave
immediately!

scripts.speaker: Elle
scripts.text:
Oh...?
{0}?
Is there anything that
I can help you with?

scripts.speaker: Elle
scripts.text:
I'm not so busy
nowadays, but I was
working hard for a while
so my body aches. Oh, what
am I saying? Please ignore
that--! Ho ho ho~

scripts.speaker: Elle
scripts.text:
Guys never understand

scripts.text:
^333333*Phew....*^000000

days I feel exhausted

scripts.speaker: Elle
scripts.text:
Jesqurienne?
Well, she's beautiful
and talented. She's actually

scripts.text:
Have you been
in Comodo before?

place with so many
things to do!

scripts.speaker: Elle
scripts.text:
I remember that
there was a lady
working for Master

I hear she's from some
distant country...

scripts.speaker: Elle
scripts.text:
La la la~~

scripts.speaker: Elle
scripts.text:
Ah~ Hello!
Nice to see

scripts.speaker: Elle
scripts.text:
^333333*Sigh...*^000000

dirt outside of the manor?

...?
*Blush~*

I should take

I like gambling in

I've seen her

about you. You're here

it tookyou to come back.
Now hurry it up and get
me ^FF000010 Coral Reefs^000000!

scripts.speaker: Arian
scripts.text:
I see, so it's my
fault for not telling you
not to bring your crap face
back without 'em. ^333333*A-hem*^000000
Don't bring your crap face here without 15 Little Evil Horns!!

scripts.speaker: Arian
scripts.text:
I don't care how pretty
they are or if you're ruining
the ecosystem! When I say
''bring ^FF000010 Coral Reefs^000000,'' you
better have them! All the
fish can die for all I care.

scripts.speaker: Arian
scripts.text:
Finally you're back.
Gimme a sec to count
all this stuff so I can make
sure you're not trying to
cheat. God help you if you
try to pull a fast one on me...!

scripts.speaker: Arian
scripts.text:
...
Alright. Go talk
to the guy to my left.
The dude at the counter.
What's-his-face, Ganaan.

scripts.speaker: Arian
scripts.text:
...
Alright. Go talk
to the guy to my left.
The dude at the counter.
What's-his-face, Ganaan.

scripts.speaker: Arian
scripts.text:
You wanna leave me
alone now and gimme
a little personal space?!
I need a break from looking
at your ugly mug, you know?

scripts.speaker: Arian
scripts.text:
Let's see...
I'm looking at your
answers and they totally
suck. Take the test again
and do it right this time!

scripts.speaker: Arian
scripts.text:
Geez...
You're givin' Ganaan
a hard time. You hear
me? That's my job!

scripts.speaker: Arian
scripts.text:
Alright. The answers
you gave Ganaan tell me
you're not a total dumbass.
Now you're supposed to go see Daewoon in Payon. And don't forget to show him this Star thingee.

scripts.speaker: Arian
scripts.text:
...........
Payon...?
Daewoon?
Any of it ring a bell?
Cuz it really oughtta!

scripts.speaker: Arian
scripts.text:
...
Shaddup and
lemme alone!
I'm thinking about
solving world hunger
here! Or somethin' like that.

scripts.speaker: Gaanan
scripts.text:
The weather here in
Morocc is too hot for me.
I'm having a hard time just
trying to live here. Do you
know a nice and cool place
where I can work?

scripts.speaker: Gaanan
scripts.text:
Oh, Arian sent you to me,
right? I'm sorry, but he takes
a little getting used to. Even
though I still have to get used
to his... mannerisms.

scripts.speaker: Gaanan
scripts.text:
Hm...?
Arian is the one
who's grading your
test. But I understand.
If you failed, I'd want
to avoid him too...

scripts.speaker: Gaanan
scripts.text:
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
I wish the weather'd
cool down, even just a little.
While I'm asking for miracles,
I may as well wish for a billion kajillion zeny. And maybe a yacht.

scripts.speaker: Gaanan
scripts.text:
Anyway, since he thinks it's
boring, Arian put me in charge
of the quiz portion of your test. Please carefully choose an
answer when I ask you a
question. Are you ready?

scripts.speaker: Gaanan
scripts.text:
Now, the first question.
Let's say that you just
found yourself on a deserted
island. What is the very first
thing that you should do?
Look for fresh water.
Just wait for rescue.
Forage for food.
Explore the island.

scripts.speaker: Gaanan
scripts.text:
The second question is...
You happen to be stuck in
a narrow place inside some
collapsed building. What
do you plan to do first?
Scream for help.
Stay quiet.
Wait for death to come.
Find a way out.

scripts.speaker: Gaanan
scripts.text:
Now, the third question.
You're on some dungeon
expedition with your friends,
but you got lost somehow.
How do you handle it?
Try to find my friends.
Find a way out.
Stay put.
Continue exploring the dungeon.

scripts.speaker: Ganaan
scripts.text:
Here's the fourth question.
You're with your friends inside
a mansion with no exit. What do
you do first when a murder happens inside the mansion?
Wait for the case to get solved.
Try to find my friends first.
Find a way out.
Solve the murder case on my own.
Kill the others before they kill me.

scripts.speaker: Gaanan
scripts.text:
The fifth question is...
You hear that the end of
the world is in one week.
So what do you do during
this final week?
Wait to see the end.
Plant an apple tree.
Look to move to a different world.
What else? Save the world.
What else? Go on a crime spree.

scripts.speaker: Gaanan
scripts.text:
Oh! We're done!
Okay, let me give
these answers to Arian.
Sooo... Talk to him and
he'll let you know how
you did.

scripts.speaker: Hagin
scripts.text:
Have you heard?
Payon's most eligible
bachelor is back home!

scripts.speaker: Hagin
scripts.text:
He was a little brat
back when he was a kid,
but now he's grown up to
be the manliest of men!
No wonder all the ladies
just can't resist him!

scripts.speaker: Hagin
scripts.text:
Heh heh...
With this beautiful
face and charming figure...
I'm gonna seduce him.
Who are you talking about?
You're freaking me out!

scripts.speaker: Hagin
scripts.text:
You don't know
Daewoon, the most
beautiful man in all
of Payon and maybe
even the world?

scripts.speaker: Hagin
scripts.text:
He left home to become stronger
when he was just a boy. I had no idea he would come back as such 
a fine specimen of a man...
I'd like to meet this Daewoon.

scripts.speaker: Hagin
scripts.text:
Oh, I see~
You plan to ask him
to show you some fighting
pointers, do you? You men
are all the same: not as
cool or tough as Daewoon!

scripts.speaker: Hagin
scripts.text:
Oh, I see~
Interested, are you?
Well, you'll have to get
in line. So many women
and only one Daewoon...
^333333*Sigh*^000000

scripts.speaker: Hagin
scripts.text:
Anyway, Daewoon
is staying in the annex
to the Payon Castle. If you
want to see him for yourself,
why don't you go there?

scripts.speaker: Hagin
scripts.text:
Freaking you out?
Excuuuuse me~!
I'll have you know that
a flower's life is brief.
I better snag Daewoon
while I still can~

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Welcome to the
Payon Castle annex
where Master Daewoon
is staying.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Welcome.
Are you another
visitor for Master
Daewoon?

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Greetings.
Welcome to the
Annex to Payon Castle.
Have you come here to
see Master Daewoon?

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Welcome to the
Payon Castle Annex.
Master Daewoon is
currently lodging here.
Have you come to see him?

scripts.speaker: Chamberlain
scripts.text:
Please refrain
from attacking
the servants.

scripts.speaker: Chamberlain
scripts.text:
Although you may recognize
us as monsters, we have
all been properly hired and
faithfully serve our master,
Daewoon. So there's no
need to feel uneasy.

scripts.speaker: Chamberlain
scripts.text:
Master Daewoon~!
Please try this too!
It's Tiger Foot Skin soup,
boiled with nine kinds of
exotic, potent herbs.

scripts.speaker: Chamberlain
scripts.text:
It's famous for easing
sores and fatigure, preventing
cold and ^333333*Ahem*^000000 enhancing male vigor. Now, open wide, master~

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Mwah ah hah!
Feasting and merriment,
wine, women and song!
I could ask for nothing more!

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
The most scrumptious
delicacies are all mine to
taste! And I'm not just talking about the food. Mwah ah hah!
I'm the king of the world!

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Oh, a visitor?
I'm sorry, but I believe
you're an uninvited guest~
You'll have to forgive me
if I wish to spend my time with maidens as opposed to men.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Oh, a visitor?
I'm sorry, but I believe
you're an uninvited guest~
No matter, a beauty is a beauty, whether or not I know her name.
Come and drink with me~

Sure...
But first, would you
take a look at this?

^3355FFYou carefully take
out the small, lucid
jewel that Arian gave
you and reveal it to
Daewoon's roving eyes.^000000

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Eh? Why that's...
I see now, Arian must
have sent you! Oh you
should have said so
at the very beginning~

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
My apologies~
Lately I've been attracting
all sorts of strange attention like some kind of teen celebrity. I've gotten used to being too careful in screening out the dangerous sort.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Now then.
Do you have any
idea what that jewel
you're holding actually is?
Kind of?
How the hell would I know?
No, but would you tell me?

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Oh...!
You must be much
smarter than I expected.
So tell me, what do you
understand about this jewel?
It's handy.
I actually don't know...

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Mmm...?
Handy? If you truly
understood, I don't
think you'd describe this
jewel as merely 'handy.'

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Really?
Mm. At least you
admit it. *Sigh*

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
...
A rather crass way
of speaking, but perhaps
you picked it up from Arian.
In any case, let me explain.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Didn't Arian tell you
anything? I appreciate
your honesty. And I don't
mind chatting a while, I much
prefer speaking to honest people rather than foolish know-it-alls.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
That ^31009CSobbing Starlight^000000
is no mere jewel. It is a key
item for unlocking some incredible power. I believe Metz happened to obtain a piece, though I am
unsure how...

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Metz has asked me and
some other friends who
hold the fragments of the
Sobbing Starlight to entrust
them to someone worthy of
finding the power it leads to.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Of course, we all agreed
and now you're here for me
to judge whether or not you're
qualified for this task. Now,
are you ready for my test?
I'M READY! YEEAH!
I'll do my best!
To hell with this!
Fine. Let's get it over with.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Ooh~
Such unbridled
enthusiasm usually
does more good than harm.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Mwah ah hah!
That's exactly what
I wanted to hear! That
kind of quiet and careful
confidence will help you
in the future, you'll see~

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
E...
Excuse me?

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
How can you be
so ridiculous at
at time like this?
Either mind your manners
or don't take this test at
all! ^333333*SLAP--!!*^000000

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Hmm. That kind of half-hearted
attitude won't get you very far on your adventures. Still, so long as you don't get overly negative, you should have a decent chance of surviving your challenges.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Now, Metz expects me to ask
some rather serious questions,
but that really isn't my style. For this test, why don't we just talk?
Just answer me honestly and
light heartedly, alright?

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
So...
Do you have a lot
of friends that you can
constantly party with?
Yes, I do.
I prefer soloing.
I am lonely.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Oh, that's great~!
To have many friends
is a priceless blessing.
Friends bring us joy and
aid when we find ourselves
suffering from difficulties.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Wouldn't you
agree that being
really close friends
with someone can be
a life long benefit?

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Well, everybody
needs to be alone once
in a while. And there are
some battles you must
fight all on your own.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Also, if you never
deal with other people,
you may grow selfish or
needy. It's better to go
out and meet people,
don't you think?

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
You don't have any
friends at all? Well,
you better learn how
to get along with others
as soon as you can...!

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Now, what's your opinion
on purposely getting lots
of monsters to follow you
around. I believe this is
called ''Mob Training...''
Awesome~!
I hate people who do that.
I do it sometimes...

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
But...
Wouldn't that be really
rude to anyone else hunting
on that same map? I think
it would even interfere with
someone else's gameplay...

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Perhaps you should try
to consider other people's
feelings. Mob Training seems
to only be good at getting other
people angry with you...

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Really?
I do too!

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Just the other day, I've
heard some ruffians boasting
of their mob training activities. But personally, I feel they were compensating for their own shortcomings.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Such behavior truly
bothers me. Although I have
spent years in developing an
unflappable personality, I find
myself irked when encountering
such troublemakers.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
When you face obstacles
in your own training, never give in to weakness. Assert yourself and find the determination to overcome your tribulations with honor!

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
At least you're honest.
But let me say that I cannot
condone that sort of weak willed behavior. True strength can only
be found through honor.
Remember that.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
In the face of overwhelming
odds, do not despair. After all, what is achievement if it is not earned without difficulty? The greater the challenge, the
greater the glory.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Even if you are having hard time,
try to take a firm stand.
One day, you will realise how strong you have become.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
And...
Don't ever partake in
mob training again, okay?

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Anyway, I'm sure you're
aware of the War of Emperium
in which mighty guilds all across Midgard battle for guild castle dominion. It's actually quite popular, really.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Now imagine that both of us
are in the midst of a heated guild war. The sounds of explosions and earth shaking magic spells are all we can hear. At any time, we can
be lost in that mindless chaos.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Finally, through incredible
good fortune, we manage to
infiltrate the enemy guild castle and reach their Emperium. If we destroy that Emperium, that castle will belong to our guild.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
However...! This is
no ordinary Emperium!
It is a masterful sculpture
of a gorgeous Priestess!
Answer me, adventurer!
Would you still destroy it?!
Destroy it!
I can't destroy such beauty...
I'd close my eyes, then destroy it.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Hmm. You have a truly
strong will. Then again,
perhaps you lack a true
appreciation for beauty.
Even in Emperium form, how
could you harm a Priestess?

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Hmm. You have a truly
strong will. Then again,
perhaps you cannot appreciate
a Priestess's beauty in the
way that a man would.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Ah yes! I felt you would answer that way! We must cherish and protect what is beautiful in this world. I would never be able to harm a Priestess, even in
statue form...

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Interesting...!
Although you cherish
the beauty of the Priestess,
your loyalty to your guild
proves stronger. A most
admirable attitude!

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
But yes, if it were
me, I would protect that
Priestess shaped Emperium
until the end of the guild war.
Mwah ah hah~!

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
While we're on the topic
of guilds, let me present
another guild related scenario. Let's say that you joined a very popular guild with many allies,
as well as formidable enemies.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Now, during one of your.
hunts, you happen to meet
a member of one of your enemy guilds. The two of you are the only people on that map. Suddenly, he finds himself in mortal danger!

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
This enemy guild member
begins to yell for help. Now,
would you give your enemy
the help that he needs?
Yes, of course!
I'd pretend not to hear anything.
I'd make fun of him, then run off.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Ah, you would help him!
Good, good. I'm glad to see
that you understand that such pettiness should not get in the way of doing what is good and right.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
True, you're not really
obligated to help your
enemy. Besides, you may
hurt his feelings once he
realizes that he's had to
depend on his rival for help.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Even though he is
your enemy, I still
believe it's important
that you treat him with
respect. Where is your honor?

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Well, there's one
last thing I want to
know about you. It's the
most important question
in the world once you
think about it.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
...
......
Do you enjoy life?
Yes
No

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
I'm glad.
When you don't live
with zeal, it's easy to
forget your goals and your
purpose for living. Don't have
any? Then make some up.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
I hope you always enjoy
life as much as you can.
As for me, I'm always happy
with my wine, women and song~
Mwah ah hah~!

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
I understand.
People cannot be happy
all the time. Sometimes
it's easy to forget your
goals and purpose in life.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
But you know what? If you
have just one dream, one goal
to strive towards, things shall get better. If you think you don't have dreams, look back to your past. What you remember may surprise you.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
It's important to look forward,
but first you must find what is truly precious to you before you can define your happiness. That's why I think it's good to experience new things as well as reflect.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Now, what's precious to me?
Three things, actually...
Wine. Women. And song!
Though, if I had to rank them,
women would top that list.
Mwah ah hah~!

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Well, I must say that I've
grown quite fond of you. Of
course, it helps that we have so much in common. Mwah ah hah~!
It was an honor to meet you~

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Oh yes! Your next test
examiner is ^CE0000Sir Jore^000000, also
known as the Ghost of Al de Baran. Although he's always sick, he has great passion for his research.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Alright, then.
Good luck in
Al de Baran~!

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
It pains me to say this,
but I do not think you're
worthy of holding my fragment
of the Sobbing Starlight. But
I am willing to give you
another chance~

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
You know, after talking with
you for a while, I now feel fairly comfortable with leaving you this piece of the Sobbing Starlight. Somehow, I think you're strong enough to get all the pieces.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
I hope you will pass the rest of the test
and acquire the power.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Oh yes! Your next test
examiner is ^CE0000Sir Jore^000000, also
known as the Ghost of Al de Baran. Although he's always sick, he has great passion for his research.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Alright, then.
Good luck in
Al de Baran~!

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
It pains me to say this,
but I do not think you're
worthy of holding my fragment
of the Sobbing Starlight. But
I am willing to give you
another chance~

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
I wonder...
Someone should have
passed Arian's test by now.
I can't wait to see who was
actually able to impress him...

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Mwah ah hah~!
I couldn't be happier!
What more do I need?
Gourmet food, fine wine,
nubile women...!

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
I'm sorry, but 
no price can make
me change my mind.
You... You've failed.
I'm sorry, friend.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Oh~! It's you!
It has been a while since
we last conversed. Now that
you've accessed the power
behind the Sobbing Starlight,
do you like it?
Yes
No

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Ah, how great~!
Just remember that
power can be addictive.
Even if you don't agree,
it's still wise to avoid
greedy tendencies, yes?

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Please make good use of
the power you have obtained.
I am counting on you to be
responsbile and to never lose
that smile on your face, okay?
Mwah ah hah~!

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Eh...?
That's quite a surprise.
Perhaps Metz didn't know
enough about it? Still, I'm
sorry to hear you don't like it.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
But in the end, keep in mind
that you must have learned some great lesson from this experience. Anyway, please do your best to use the power responsibly, okay?
Mwah ah hah~!

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Hm...?
Weren't you on
your way to find
^CE0000Sir Jore^000000 in Al de Baran?

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Oh, having trouble
finding him, are you?
Well, he's fairly shy, but
I'm sure he's hiding some
place in that town.

scripts.speaker: Daewoon
scripts.text:
Ah, I feel so...
Satiated. The food was 
stupendous and the women
have been even more so.
Servants! Fan me please~

scripts.speaker: Sir Jore
scripts.text:
Uwah~!
Stop reading my
research monograph!
Put that back now!
Excuse me...

scripts.speaker: Sir Jore
scripts.text:
...
......
...No!
Look what
you made me do!

scripts.speaker: Sir Jore
scripts.text:
I've been fiddling
with this sample for
five hours. And now
it's ruined! ^333333*Sob*^000000

scripts.speaker: Sir Jore
scripts.text:
^333333*Sob*^000000
I came to this town
so I could focus on
my research without
any interruptions. So
why are you here?
Daewoon sent me.
Oops, sorry. Later~

scripts.speaker: Sir Jore
scripts.text:
O-oh!
That's right.
You're here to be
tested for the piece
of the Sobbing Starlight.

scripts.speaker: Sir Jore
scripts.text:
So...
Er. Then, what...
W-what's your name?
{0}, thanks.

scripts.speaker: Sir Jore
scripts.text:
N-nice to meet you.
My name is Jore. Just
a normal person who loves
research. S-sorry if I seem
a little nervous! I'm actually
quite... shy around people.

scripts.speaker: Sir Jore
scripts.text:
Oh no...!
If you were able to
find me, there will be
others! When would I get
the time to do my research?!
N-no! I h-h-hate people!!

scripts.speaker: Sir Jore
scripts.text:
Still, I did promise
M-M-Metz and he is my
friend. So I must accept
some guests. Even if hundreds
of them knock on my door...

scripts.speaker: Sir Jore
scripts.text:
But first of all,
I'm going to need
a new research sample.
I think it's only fair that
you get it for me since you
made me ruin the last one.

scripts.speaker: Sir Jore
scripts.text:
N-now, d-don't worry.
The items are actually
quite easy to get. It's
five hours part that's
hard. Now, let's see...

scripts.speaker: Sir Jore
scripts.text:
Just bring me
10 Empty Test Tubes,
10 Green Herbs and
2 Yggdrasil Leafs.

scripts.speaker: Sir Jore
scripts.text:
You see, l-lately I've
been studying Biology. 
I think the secret to life
can be found in the Leaf of
Yggdrasil. They can be used
to revive the dead, after all.

scripts.speaker: Sir Jore
scripts.text:
Oh, and make sure to
bring those things to me
me before I go to bed at
precisely 10:00 PM PST.
I do have a regular sleeping
schedule, you know.

scripts.speaker: Sir Jore
scripts.text:
I spent five hours

this forge isn't really open to the public. I'm doing some intensive training,so I'd appreciate it if you would just leave now.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
^333333*Sigh*^000000
It's been a long
time since I've seen
my family. I really should let them know how I'm doing sooner or later. Hmmm....

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: As I've told you before, I'm more likely to succeed in my work if I'm able to use a higher quality anvil. Let's me see what you've brought...

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Are you back already?
Sorry, but I haven't quite finished yet. I won't be done for a while, so why don't you deliver that letter to my family?

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Are you back already?
While you were gone, I managed to restore this Sobbing Starlight. Why don't you go ahead and take a look?

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
You've returned?
Well, I don't know how to put this, but once you hear it, don't take it the wrong way...

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Oh good, you're back.
I've got some bad news,
so please don't overreact~
Um, are you ready?

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Didn't I tell you to bring me a Golden Anvil or an Emperium Anvil? Anything less isn't good enough to do any restoration work on this Sobbing Starlight.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Good, good.
I see that you've brought a Golden Anvil. Now I can get started right away! Still, I'm a little about those monsters showing up again, so would you keep a lookout?

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Excellent! You've brought an Emperium Anvil! Now, keep a lookout for monsters while I repair these ore fragments. We can't have those beasts ruin my work again, right? Thank you.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Oh, you don't have everything ready yet? Take your time, so long as you didn't forget what you needed to bring. You do remember, right?

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Still don't have everything ready? That's fine, just take your time. So long as you haven't forgotten all the things that you need. I mean, how can you forget when you have such an important ore on you?

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: How have you been doing lately? Feel free to ask me if you ever think that you need my expertise, alright?

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
How have you been
doing lately? You seem
quite well. So is there anything
I can help you with today?

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
It's so...
Beautiful! I don't know
if I'll ever see anything
like this again in my life...

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: I haven't completed it yet, but please understand that I've got to be really careful when working with something so valuable. But don't worry, its inner power will be revealed when I'm finished.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Sometimes, you can only
improve yourself by training in solitude. But don't ever forget about the ones who really care about you. It's those people who make everything worth it.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Oh great! I see that you're
carrying some Iron Ores with you. Would you be so kind as to lend me 1 Iron Ore? Please, I beg of you...
Sure, why not?
Sorry, I can't.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Thank you so much!
If it weren't for your help,
I'd be in big trouble. I really appreciate you stepping in and volunteering your materials like this.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
I suppose I understand.
However, you're lucky that I don't kick you out of my forge right here and right now~

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
...?
Were you looking for me?
I'm sorry, but I'm busy at the moment. Please don't disturb me while I try to get my work done.
I need your help.
Here is a letter for you.
I am leaving, leaving.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Well, I'd like to help you,
but now isn't a good for me.
plenty of other good smiths out there who can help you with the work that you want done. Farewell.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Oh, are you serious?
Let me read it first.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Yes, yes.
...Hahaha!
It's so good to hear from
my darling daughter.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Thanks, I really appreciate that you've delivered this letter for me. Now, is there anything you'd like to ask of me? If it's not a big favor, I can probably help you.
Please look at this.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Oh?
Isn't this...?
I see, I see!

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Long ago, my old master told me that there are these strange ores that have fallen from the sky. The most beautiful and mysterious is the one shines just like a star.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Most people may know it as Sobbing Starlight, but my master used to call it God's Tear Drop.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: However, this ore has been shattered into pieces. Judging from the smoothness of the edges, its inner power must have caused it to break apart. So you want me to put this back together, don't you?

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
This will be a good challenge
for me! However, I'll need some
special tools and materials to repair this kind of ore. Now, I want you to bring me the following things...

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
^FF00005 Mini Furnace^000000,
^FF00002 Oridecon Hammer^000000,
and ^ff00001 good quality Anvil^000000.
Now keep in mind that ordinary anvils won't be good enough for
this kind of work.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Now, an Emperium Anvil would be ideal for this job. I used to have one, but a while back I ended up giving it to someone. Anyway, I'll wait here for you while you gather everything you need.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Right. Let me guide you to a shortcut to the exit of these mines, just in case you don't know your way out of here. Good luck~

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Alright, then.
Take care.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
...?
Do you have any business
me? I'm sorry, but right
now I'm very busy. Please leave
me alone to my research.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
A...
Regular Anvil?
Alright, I guess I'll try it.
But I can't guarantee success.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Ah...
An Oridecon Avil.
This isn't too bad,
but there's a good risk
that this might not work.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Ah...
A Golden Anvil.
This just might be able to do the job. This might take a while, so I have something to ask of you.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Oh wow, an Emperium Anvil!
And this looks like one I might have actually made. Great, I should be able to do this so long as I don't make any critical mistakes~

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: While I'm working on this, would you deliver a letter to my family for me? I'm sorry, but please consider that I'm waiving the fee for restoring this Sobbing Starlight.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Well then...
I wish you safety
in your travels.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Oh, you don't have everything ready yet? Take your time, so long as you didn't forget what you needed to bring. You do remember, right?

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
^FF00005 Mini Furnace^000000,
^FF00002 Oridecon Hammer^000000,
and ^ff00001 good quality Anvil^000000.
That's all you need!

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Remember that I have a greater chance of repairing the Sobbing Starlight if I have access to a higher quality Anvil. Otherwise...

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Still don't have everything ready? That's fine, just take your time. So long as you haven't forgotten all the things that you need. I mean, how can you forget when you have such an important ore on you?

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: This was one of the most difficult jobs I've ever done. But look! It was beautiful when broken in fragments but now it's absolutely dazzling! This was really worth my effort.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: In any case, I worked really hard to do a good job on this, so I hope you treasure this Sobbling Starlight, young adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
^333333*Ahem*^000000
Just as I've warned you, this attempt to restore the Sobbling Starlight failed because the anvil you gave me wasn't up to the job. I'm sorry about that.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
However, I only
broke all of the tools
and the ore pieces are still intact. Now, if you bring me the tools one more time, I can try this again.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Since I'm a bit more familiar with this material, I won't take so much time. Once again, let me tell you which things you need to bring...

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
^FF00005 Mini Furnace^000000,
^FF00002 Oridecon Hammer^000000,
and ^ff00001 good quality Anvil^000000.
And this time, bring
me a better anvil, huh?

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Although it'd be perfect if I had an Emperium Anvil, I'm pretty sure it'll be alright if we used a Golden Anvil.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
While I was trying to restore the 
Sobbling Starlight, I was attacked 
by monsters all of a sudden. If only
I paid more attention to my
surroundings...

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Please understand that I get very deeply engrossed in my smithing work. If you don't mind, I'll try this again you'll bring all the tools just like the last time.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
^FF00005 Mini Furnace^000000 and
^FF00002 Oridecon Hammer^000000.
Don't forget the ^FF0000Golden Anvil^000000! But if you can get your hands on one, an ^FF0000Emperium Anvil^000000 would be better.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Next time you come
here, bring a Golden or Emperium Anvil and make sure to leave all of your other anvils in Kafra Storage or something, okay?

^3355FF*Clink*
*Clink Clink Clink*
*Clink Clink Clink*
*Cliiiiiiiiiiiiink*^000000

^3355FF*Clink*
*Clink-Clink*
*Clink-Clink-Clink*
*Claaaaaaaaaaack*^000000

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
It's almost done.
Just be a bit more patient...

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Finally... Completed.
^333333*Phew!*^000000 That was one of the toughest jobs I've ever done, but this was well worth all of our efforts. Just look at the dazzling beauty of this Sobbing Starlight!

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: We've both gone through a lot of trouble to make this, so I hope you treasure your Sobbing Starlight. Good luck on your adventures...

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
^FF00005 Mini Furnace^000000,
^FF00002 Oridecon Hammer^000000,
and ^ff00001 good quality Anvil^000000.
That's all you need!

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text: Remember that I have a greater chance of repairing the Sobbing Starlight if I have access to a higher quality Anvil. Otherwise...
I need your help again.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Haha, so what have
you brought me this time?
It must be fairly important if you've brought it all the way
down here.
Please look at this.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Isn't this...?!
Amazing, just by looking at it,
I can feel its power! You really
are something! How do you come across all of this amazing stuff?

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
You know, I consider myself
lucky to even see this kind of stuff. Most smiths might be able to see this kind of thing only once in their entire lives. And to be able to work on it...

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
It's going to take quite
a while to work on this. Unfortunately, I can't even
give you a time estimate...
But I'll do my best for you.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
Oh, you're back just in time.
Although it was one of my most difficult jobs, I believe you'll be pleased with my work. Only a few smiths are privileged enough to work with this, even just once.

scripts.speaker: Engel
scripts.text:
This is now yours to keep.
Thank you for giving me the
honor of working on a worthy
smithing challenge.

scripts.speaker: Dhota
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
That can't be right...
What could possibly be
the answer I'm looking
for? ^333333*Sigh...*^000000

scripts.speaker: Dhota
scripts.text:
Wah~
Why the hell did he even go there...!
What are you doing here?!

scripts.speaker: Dhota
scripts.text:
You're not even a Mage,
much less a Wizard, Sage, Warlock or a Sorcerer.
Why bother climbing this tower?
What are you doing here?!

scripts.speaker: Dhota
scripts.text:
Eh?
Did you just say you're
here for Metz Brayde?
For that Sobbing Starlight, is that right?

scripts.speaker: Dhota
scripts.text:
Eh?
For that Sobbing Starlight, is that right?

scripts.speaker: Dhota
scripts.text:
Eh?
Did you just say you're
here for Metz Brayde?

scripts.speaker: Dhota
scripts.text: Eh?

scripts.speaker: Dhota
scripts.text:
Right, he wants that guy
who's good at working with
gems and stuff. Eh, he's not
here right now. Went somewhere
near Comodo to investigate some
tribal people or whatever.

scripts.speaker: Dhota
scripts.text:
Say what...?
I have no idea what
you're talking about!
If you've got nothing
to say, then leave me alone!

scripts.speaker: Laotan
scripts.text:
Oh, I wish I had
a Mr. Smile mask!
But where can I get
one of those? Well, I'd
be happy if I had some
Meat to eat, I guess!

scripts.speaker: Laotan
scripts.text:
Mmm...?
A new guy in our village?
I think I know him! Yea, I do!

scripts.speaker: Laotan
scripts.text:
I love my Mr. Smile mask
soooo much! I'm gonna show
it to all my friends! Thank you
so much again! You're really
really nice, you know that?

scripts.speaker: Laotan
scripts.text:
Oh my gosh!
You've got a Mr. Smile mask!
Would you give that to me?
Pretty please...?

scripts.speaker: Laotan
scripts.text:
Waaaait.
I knooow~!
I know if you get
me a Mr. Smile, okay?
Sure~

scripts.speaker: Laotan
scripts.text:
Hooooray!
Thank you thank you
thank you thank you
soooooooooo much!

scripts.speaker: Laotan
scripts.text:
Oh right~!
The weird man in the funny clothes was in our village for a while, but ever since he went into that big tree, nobody's seen him!

scripts.speaker: Laotan
scripts.text:
I...
I was...
I just...
Waaaaaaahhhh!

Chuuuba?
Chu-chu-chu-chu-chaba?
Oom oom oom daba. Blip blip?
Sabaloo koombah Solo. Ho ho~

So if I do this,
then that and then...
Ooh, these calculations
are absolutely perfect!

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
Wh-what?!
Who are you?
H-how did you get
in here? I demand
that you leave, right now!

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
^333333*Giggle*^000000
So if I do this,
then that and then...
Ooh, these calculations
are absolutely perfect!

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
Wh-what?!
Who are you?
H-how did you get
in here? I demand
that you leave, right now!
I'm here for Metz Brayde.
My apologies.
Would you look at this?

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
Huh? Brayde?
Do you expect me
to just trust you without
a single shred of proof that
he sent you? Get out now!

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
If you're so sorry,
then hurry up and get
out of here! Not just anyone
is allowed here! Leave!

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
What could be so
special about what
you've brought here?!
Fine, you've piqued my
scientific curiosity...

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
Sweet lord...
This is 'God's Tear Drop!'
The Sobbling Starlight!
He finally made it....

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
^333333*Giggle*^000000
Well, since he's kept his promise, I suppose that I should keep mine
as well. Now, within this Sobbing Starlight are these tiny letters... ^FFFFFFcobo^000000

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
The text is so small that even Hunters skilled in Vulture's Eye are unable to read them. However, I've read that this Sobbing
Starlight will respond
to really old papers...

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
Now, if we want to figure out
what's written in the Sobbing
Starlight, we'd need at least
10 ancient pieces of paper...

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
Not listening, eh?
Fine, if you don't
understand words, then
I'll have to use force!
Get out here right now!

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
You've come back.
I hope you were able
to find some ancient
or really aged paper...

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
How did you find these
Worn Out Pages? This is great,
I'm sure the Sobbing Starlight
will respond to these!

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
Yes. Yes...
This should be enough.
Now give them to me
and wait here while
I try a few things...

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
Just as I thought!
The Sobbing Starlight is responding to these Worn Out Pages! Excellent! I've finally fulfilled my promise to Metz! Now he can leave
me alone!

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
How did you find these
^FF0000Worn Out Pages^000000? This is great,
I'm sure the Sobbing Starlight
will respond to these!

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
Wait, we don't have enough
of them to make the Sobbing
Starlight respond. Find more
of these papers and bring
them all to me!

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
You haven't found anything?
What kind of scientist are you?
Now go out and find some old and ancient papers so that we can learn what's written in the Sobbing Starlight! Go!

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
...?
Why are you still here?
Leave and do what I told
you to do, alright?! Don't
make me get violent...

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text: My business with you is finished, so you go along on your way now. And tell Metz not to bother me anymore! I'm done doing favors!

scripts.speaker: Cyon
scripts.text:
How dare you intrude
on my property?! Now,
get out now before I get
violent! Didn't you hear me?
GET OUT OF HERE!

^3355FFWait a second! Right now,
you have too many items in your inventory. Please come back after you've freed up more inventory space.^000000

scripts.speaker: Frank
scripts.text:
My back~
It's so sore!
And my eyes are
hurting worse and worse.
^333333*Sigh*^000000 I'm getting old...

scripts.speaker: Frank
scripts.text:
My vision's getting
blurrier and I get headaches
when I read. I guess this old
man's got no choice but to get
some sort of seeing aid...

scripts.speaker: Frank
scripts.text:
I've finally completed the translation. It was a challenge deciphering the meaning of some
of these words. Even translated in our own language, this contents of this text are fairly ambiguous.

scripts.speaker: Frank
scripts.text:
I'm sorry, but I haven't finished translating this text. It's taking quite a long time since I don't have any reference material for this particular language. Why
don't you come back later?

scripts.speaker: Frank
scripts.text:
There are many things out
there that defy our understanding of the world and are beyond our imagination. Many fear the unknown, but the truly brave will always seek out the truth.
Wait, I've got a pair of glasses...
Pass on by.

scripts.speaker: Frank
scripts.text:
Oh, you've brought me
these Glasses? Thanks
so much, youngster. Now that
I can see better, what can
I do for you in return?
About Geffen's Hidden Power
About Sobbing Starlight
Interpret Ancient Document

scripts.speaker: Frank
scripts.text:
Geffen's hidden power?
I don't know much about it, but I'm sure that Geffen Tower is more than just a simple building. I'm sure it was created to restrain or contain some powerful force.

scripts.speaker: Frank
scripts.text: It's even possible that the fountain in front of Geffen Tower also plays the same role, but I've got no hard evidence. Since I'm not too interested in Geffen, I haven't really investigated...

scripts.speaker: Frank
scripts.text:
Still...
There's a strong possibility that some enormous power is being sealed beneath the Geffen Tower.

scripts.speaker: Frank
scripts.text:
The Sobbing Starlight?
To the experts, it's known as God's Tear Drop. Now, some believe it was created from the voice of God.

scripts.speaker: Frank
scripts.text: Of course, it probably isn't made from God's voice or tear drops, but who knows? In any case, it's said that something's written in the Sobbing Starlight. What ever it is, it must be something important...

scripts.speaker: Frank
scripts.text:
I don't believe it!
This is... I see. You want me to translate this ancient language. Ah, you're rather fortunate. I'm probably the only person in the world who can translate this.

scripts.speaker: Frank
scripts.text: Hmm, as far as I can tell, this is a sophisticated language spoken by the ancient gods. It's complex and confusing, but I'll do my best for you. Come back to me later, and I'll what I've learned.

scripts.speaker: Frank
scripts.text:
Oooh~
How will I ever
be able to continue
my life's work? I'm
helpless if I can't read...

scripts.speaker: Frank
scripts.text:
Well, I've written down the best translation that I could for you. It's been a long time since I've had this kind of challenge. Thanks, youngster.
Ha ha ha~

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
Only the chosen
can enter this place.
I will not ask how you've
gained entrance, but I will
require you to leave.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
Welcome, {0},
to this realm of holiness.
You have endured great difficulty and tested your courage to obtain the Sobbing Starlight, which will be the certificate for your test.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
I commend your ability
to survive in the realm
of the dead. I imagine it
must be very difficult for
a mortal to endure its cruelty.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
Regrettably, I can't really
provide any answers for you.
You must overcome the ordeals
of the gods on your own. All I can do is offer my guidance and prayer. ^FFFFFFcobo^000000

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
Welcome back.
Not only have you passed the trials that the gods have set for you, you have tested your courage in the realm of the dead and protected Midgard from attack.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
The gods are watching
you. Prove your courage,
and at that moment, you
will earn the honor of being
selected by the gods.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
You have yet to
fully prove your courage.
Once you do, you will be
summoned by the gods.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
The gods are disappointed
in what you have decided to
do. Unfortunately, you have
been banished from Valhalla
and this place as well.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
Great warrior,
your time has not yet
come. Please focus on
your training until you
are summoned by the gods...
Test...?

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
The gods have decided that
you are worthy of undergoing
a special test that will judge
your merits. If you are a true
hero who is pure of heart,
you will certainly succeed...

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
Now, there is a critical
situation in the ^FF0000realm where
the fallen warriors dwell^000000. The
gods wish for you to restore the balance by quelling a specific
evil influence in that place.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
There will be many obstacles.
First, the fallen, who will target their anger and hatred towards
you. Where they have failed to
enter Valhalla, you have a rare
and wondrous opportunity...

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
Secondly, and more
importantly, you must find
this evil influence on your
own. This will judge your
ability to discern good from evil. Do not trust appearances...

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
This is your task.
I cannot tell you more.
It is now your duty to
travel there and ferret
out true darkness from
one of the hearts there...

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
Remember that the
demonstration of your belief,
rather than the decision to
blindly adhere to faith, is
what the gods want to see.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
Always step forward
with wisdom and courage.
That is all I can tell you.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text: I'm pleased to announce that the gods have been watching you and decided to invite you to Valhalla. However, Midgard still has great need of you.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text: As a symbol of this promise to invite you to Valhalla, you shall be rewarded with 'The Sign' which will show all others that you are a great warrior whose courage was tested by the gods themselves.

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
Congratulations,
{0}. Verily,
you are an honorable
hero worthy of praise!

scripts.speaker: Valkyrie Sandra
scripts.text:
Although you have failed,
I hope that you find your
another way to win back
the favor of the gods...

scripts.speaker: Serin
scripts.text:
As its magic power grows,
the Magic Circle is nearing completion. The symbol which I've asked you for is the last material needed for summoning Dark Lord.

scripts.speaker: Serin
scripts.text:
However, the power of that
symbol can be used to complete
the Magic Circle or destroy it.
Would you hand it over to me?
I choose to destroy this...

scripts.speaker: Serin
scripts.text:
Please...
